Accessible in-place game settings editor.

    - Up/Down arrows change values on number, choice, and bool fields.
    - Direct digit typing (0-9) and Backspace edit number fields in-place.
    - Enter and Tab advance focus to the next setting / 'Start Game'.
    - Shift+Tab and Up arrow on action items navigate backwards.
    - Enter on 'Start Game' starts the game immediately.

Accessible table view for TableVerse UNO.

Features:
- Clean 3-point TAB order:
  - Before start: main gameplay focus -> Chat -> Log
  - After start: gameplay/hand -> Chat -> Log
- Pure card names on focus without redundant prefixes or labels.
- Wild color picker modal (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) with "Choose color" speech.
- Clean separation between waiting lobby and gameplay.
